newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes almost unchanged vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes almost unchanged vs dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed virtually unchanged against the dollar on Tuesday as the dollar-rupee exchange rate hovered close to the central bank's selling level, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 59.36 to the dollar after opening at 59.35 and slipping to the 59.40 level in the morning, they said.
The central bank, responding to the dollar's lack of movement overseas, kept its rate unchanged from Monday's buying and selling prices of 58.1947 and 59.3703.
Speculators were absent, with the exchange rate near the central bank's ceiling, dealers said.
"Agressive buying by one bank resulted in one-month premiums going up more than 40 cents per month," a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said.
Overnight call money opened at 9.5 percent and closed at the same level.
